summary: Air T Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $8 million of common stock through Ascendiant Capital Markets as sales agent. Sales will occur at prevailing market prices on NASDAQ; the agent earns a 3% commission. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The company notes compliance with Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6 due to its public float of ~$27.1 million. No merger, tender, spin-off, activist, or restructuring is involved. Watch for dilution risk but no arbitrage angle.
